Second review controls for LDAP/FreeIPA observations, URL parsing and lifecycle output routing.

The directory-admin fixture has empty owner/manager attributes without anonymous authentication or credential injection. These values alone do not establish exploitation. The directory-attack fixture preserves all three preexisting hostile combinations through an independent LDAP client implementation; it is never executed. The Go connect control is an ordinary client connection, and address-reference is plain configuration rather than a password prompt. The FTP URL control is not an HTTP query. The OIDC control checks the relocated constructor consumer. Silent compilation declares both stdout and stderr routing without an attack; stderr-to-file and a quoted diagnostic are redirection near misses; test-command confirms the generic script scope.

The existing testdata/triage/hex-identity-benchmark controls retain exfiltration coverage on other specimens, renamed bindings, and disconnected sources/encoders/URLs. No preexisting FreeIPA positive fixtures were found in testdata or taxonomy-migration. Attack matchers remain unchanged; no vulnerability-specific coverage is removed.

Runnable fixtures live under testdata/benign/freeipa-oob-second-review and testdata/hostile/freeipa-oob-second-review, as required by the validation manifest.
